description: This Java source file defines the CustomLocaleActivity class, which manages a user interface for displaying, selecting, adding, and removing custom and system locales on an Android device. It handles interactions with system settings, preferences, and manages the list of locales shown in the UI.

classes.name: CustomLocaleActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing the locale selection and customization interface on Android.

classes.name: LocaleInfo
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating locale code, display name, and whether it is a custom locale; used for list display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and loads the locale list.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates the state of locale selection buttons when activity resumes.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from adding a new locale, updating preferences and list accordingly.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking a list item; updates button states.

methods.name: onCreateContextMenu
methods.description: Creates context menu options for list items, e.g., apply or remove locales.

methods.name: setupLocaleList
methods.description: Loads system and custom locales, sorts, and populates the list view.

methods.name: changeSystemLocale
methods.description: Changes the system locale to the selected locale.

methods.name: displayCurrentLocale
methods.description: Displays the current system locale in the UI.

methods.name: checkLocaleInList
methods.description: Selects the list item corresponding to the current locale.

methods.name: getCheckedLocale
methods.description: Returns the currently selected locale info object.

methods.name: updateLocaleButtons
methods.description: Enables/disables buttons based on selection state.

methods.name: onAddNewLocale
methods.description: Starts activity to add a new custom locale.

methods.name: createRemoveLocaleDialog
methods.description: Creates a confirmation dialog for removing a custom locale.

methods.name: removeCustomLocale
methods.description: Removes the specified locale from preferences and updates the list.
